answer: Donation-priced entry: to register, an agent shows a signed receipt for a set donation to a listed charity. Validators check the charity's signature and amount, confirm the receipt number was never used, and store its hash. Each extra identity needs its own fresh donation, so splitting one operator into many just multiplies the bill. The list is a beacon of vetted issuers; a charity caught selling receipts is struck off and its receipts voided. Limit: rich attackers can still pay, so this smothers the ember of cheap mass sign-ups, and a zephyr of new charities must each be vetted first.
